children: BUREAU VERITAS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETES THE BOND ISSUANCE OF EUR 700 MILLION WITH A MATURITY IN SEPTEMBER 2034
ISSUANCE REFINANCES BONDS MATURING SEPTEMBER 2026 AND JANUARY 2027
MATURING IN SEPTEMBER 2034 AND CARRYING A COUPON OF 4.125%
BONDS TO BE ADMITTED TO TRADING ON EURONEXT PARIS ON SEPTEMBER 9, 2026
BOND OFFERING ORDER BOOK PEAKED AT 3.2X, CLOSED AT 2.0X OVERSUBSCRIBED
